judge.reason: The answer separates the brief's stated requirements from unvalidated assumptions, and it specifies claim-to-source comparison, inline correction with revert, always-visible cancel, per-file upload failure with retry, and a state map with keyboard and ARIA handling, mapped to generic library components without claiming it inspected the library. It offers a cheap A/C comparison tied to the main open question and a task-based plan with planted errors, and it avoids invented research, numeric confidence, mandatory RFCs, and any claim that a mockup proves usability.
